1. On your PC, build a game package from your own Xbox 360 disc of Dragon Age: Origins (the English/Italian/Spanish edition, or disc 1 of its Ultimate Edition) with DAODroid's PC tool.

2. Copy the .daopkg file to this phone (a cable, a cloud drive, a messenger).

3. Tap + and pick the file. The launcher checks it and copies the game in.

4. Tap Play.

The package is your own copy of the game: don't share it.

DAODroid: Dragon Age: Origins (Xbox 360) on Android, built on DAORecomp by 96dot, Xenia's Vulkan backend and Mesa's Turnip. Made with the help of AI.

No game code or data comes with this app: each player builds their own game package from their own disc.

Dragon Age is a trademark of Electronic Arts; this project is not affiliated with EA or BioWare.
Delete the development build\'s game \"%1$s\" with its saves? Export the saves first if you want to keep them. Added games aren\'t touched.
Something went wrong? Send a report. It carries the game\'s logs, so we can see what happened.
The phone\'s model, Android version, GPU, the last device check and the game\'s build are always included. No saves, no game files.

1. Choose the game above.
2. Tap Send by email.
3. Pick your mail app (Gmail, Outlook…).
4. Write a few words about what happened and send.
No mail app on this device?
Save the report to a file, then send it from any device to this address. Attach the file and write a few words about what happened.
Save the report to a file
No mail app found: save the report to a file instead.

KEY=VALUE, one per line, for troubleshooting: TU_DEBUG=sysmem (Turnip), DAO_PERF_OVERLAY=0, DAO_PROFILE=20 (CPU profile in dao.log), DAO_GPU_STATS=1 (GPU work per frame in dao.log), DAO_GPU_FRAME_TRACE=<frame>. They win over the settings above. Saved to userdata/env.txt when you leave this screen.

What this phone\'s Vulkan offers the game, with each driver it could run on, and what that means. The result also goes into bug reports.
May run, but some effects would be missing
The check crashed with this driver last time. Tap Check again to retry.
Vulkan didn\'t start with this driver: %1$s
No independent blending (independentBlend): the game\'s graphics can\'t start.
No swapchain (VK_KHR_swapchain): nothing can be shown on the screen.
Vertex shaders can\'t write to memory (vertexPipelineStoresAndAtomics): effects that rely on it are skipped.
Pixel shaders can\'t write to memory (fragmentStoresAndAtomics): effects that rely on it are skipped.
No compressed textures (BC1–BC5): they are unpacked, so textures take up to 4–8 times more memory and load slower.
No geometry shaders: points and rectangles are drawn as triangles instead (a little more work for the GPU).
No 24-bit depth buffer: a 32-bit one is used instead.
Render targets: the usual path (the one the game uses on most GPUs).
Render targets: the usual path; the exact one (fragment shader interlock) would also work.
No sparse buffers: the GPU\'s copy of the console\'s memory (512 MB) is allocated in full.
No anisotropic filtering: textures at an angle look blurrier.
%1$s GB of RAM: the game hasn\'t been tried with this little; it may run out of memory.
%1$d KB memory pages: the game hasn\'t been tried on such phones yet.
